view.name: Live Audio Chat Translator
view.description: Live English captions from chat audio on your computer — built for X/Twitter Spaces. Captures what you hear, translates as people speak, and labels lines with the active speaker from the Spaces sidebar.

memory.content: Owner uses this live audio translator for X/Twitter Spaces and wants speaker names next to translated English captions.

Live caption pipeline: capture system/speaker loopback on the owner's Windows PC, run faster-whisper (base, CPU int8 if CUDA libs are missing) with task=translate to English, append lines to a local captions.jsonl via live_captioner.py. Stop by creating a STOP file in that working folder. Audio is often non-English (e.g. Hindi/Urdu).

Speaker labels for X Spaces come from OCR of the Spaces sidebar purple equalizer (active mic); speaker_detect.py is used by live_captioner.py. Names are often truncated in the UI and expanded via a small map of common short forms.

Speaker attribution rule: never fall back to the browser tab title for who is speaking. Detect the active X Spaces speaker from the full virtual desktop Spaces panel using mute-icon column density plus purple equalizer / unmuted scoring.
